prompt:
The section sections/lookbook-grid-defaults.liquid renders a lookbook grid. It works, but it breaks when merchants leave settings empty. Change the markup so that it applies the default values and rules below. Keep the existing {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Inputs (all are under the top-level object `section`): - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.settings.columns: integer or null. It can be outside the range 2-4. - section.blocks: array (possibly empty) of objects. Each object has `settings` with: - settings.image: string or null (image URL) - settings.caption: string or null Rules: 1. Heading: strip leading and trailing whitespace from section.settings.heading. If the result is empty, or the value is null, use the text `Shop the look`. Output the heading HTML-escaped. 2. Columns: if null, use 3. Otherwise clamp the value to the range 2-4: values below 2 become 2, and values above 4 become 4. 3. Looks: process blocks in order. Strip settings.image. If the result is empty, or the value is null, skip the block entirely. A skipped block does not count toward numbering. Each rendered look gets a 1-based position N, counting only rendered looks. 4. Caption: strip settings.caption. If the result is empty, or the value is null, use `Look N`, where N is the look's position. Output the caption HTML-escaped. 5. Output the stripped image URL HTML-escaped in data-image. 6. If no looks are rendered, output `

No looks yet

` in place of the list. Exact output, with no whitespace or newlines between tags: `

HEADING

LIST
` LIST is either the empty-state paragraph or: `
    ITEMS
` Each item is: `
    • ` HTML escaping means escaping & < > and " as & < > ". Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/lookbook-grid-defaults.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
